value: Blade & Sorcery is a medieval fantasy VR game distinguished by its realistic, physics-driven combat system. Players engage in highly interactive melee, ranged, and magic combat, where object weight, hitboxes, and environmental interactions are physically simulated. The game offers a narrative-driven "Crystal Hunt" progression mode with extensive skill trees and lore exploration, alongside an unrestricted "Sandbox" mode providing access to a wide array of weapons and armor for creative fighting styles. Exclusively designed for virtual reality and featuring mature content due to frequent violence and gore, Blade & Sorcery has received overwhelmingly positive customer reviews.
